description: Burn subtitles from an SRT onto a video. Built-in layout: FontSize=20; WrapStyle=0 (smart wrap between CJK chars—2 disables wrapping and can clip); MarginV auto (~2% of video height, clamped 12–50); BorderStyle=1; Outline=1; BackColour=&H80000000 (semi-transparent). Auto line wrapping is always on (CJK lines capped ~34 chars based on video width and font size). Override visuals with font_style, e.g. {"font_size":"22","font_color":"&H00FFFFFF","outline_color":"&H00000000","back_colour":"&H80000000","margin_v":"36","wrap_style":"0"}. Honored keys: font_name, font_size, font_color/primary_color, outline_color, outline_width, shadow_color, shadow_offset_x/y, alignment, margin_v/l/r, wrap_style, border_style, back_colour.
